note.en: Read each full word. The refrigerator appears with optional 电 on the board. Desktop and laptop forms are distinct. These are word connections, not invented historical etymologies.

A + 比 + B + adjective compares A with B. 多了 and 得多 can strengthen a degree; 一点儿 can soften it. Do not add 很 automatically. 倍 describes a multiplicative relation and needs explicit context: the board list is not a rule that every adjective accepts every modifier. Classroom prices are examples, not verified current prices.
Guess an age with 猜 and 岁. V-一-V is a light invitation to try; 一 is light/neutral in 猜一猜. The sports word is 世界杯. The number 30 is written out as 三十 in learning text.

Use 口 when counting family members. 两个 and 三个 count older sisters. The source answer contains an unfilled slot; do not invent a private family history or turn the fragment into a factual personal answer.

The table gives November 2 / Monday, November 3 / Tuesday and November 4 / Wednesday. Repeated 月, 号 and 星期 are expanded from the table heading. The ambiguous 10.30 / 六 annotation is preserved in source notes, not silently taught as a verified date.
在 + place answers a location question. 哪儿 has a rhotic ending; 哪里 is another form of where. 饭店 is restaurant in this classroom contrast, while 酒店 is hotel; real usage of 饭店 can also mean hotel.

在 + action describes an action in progress here. 现在 can make now explicit. 一直 stresses continuation; 总是 stresses habitual repetition, so they are not universally interchangeable. 干 has different readings and meanings: gàn (do/work) and gān (dry).

Choose the classifier with the noun: 条 for the displayed trousers/quilt/skirt, 双 for pairs, 件 for a shirt, 辆 for a car, 本 for books, 张 for a sheet/table/bed. 一 has dictionary tone yī; spoken quantity phrases show yì before non-fourth-tone classifiers and yí before fourth-tone classifiers.
